objective: Endurecer el worker para que la cola universal sea siempre el primer plano de control de cada ciclo y para que ningun subprocess del worker o del launcher pueda bloquear indefinidamente la recepcion de jobs. Aplicar timeouts fail-safe a bridge, dispatcher, publisher, health, mirror check/apply/publish/finalize y reporting. No tocar Produccion.

actions.old:
while [ "$RUNNING" -eq 1 ]; do
    run_cycle
    receive_universal_jobs
    dispatch_universal_jobs
    publish_universal_results
    publish_runtime_health
    run_reporting_pipeline
    [ "$RUNNING" -ne 0 ] || break
    sleep "$LOOP_SECONDS" & wait $! || true
done
actions.new:
while [ "$RUNNING" -eq 1 ]; do
    # La cola universal es el plano de control: atenderla antes de cualquier
    # sincronizacion de mirror evita starvation aunque una tarea posterior sea lenta.
    receive_universal_jobs
    dispatch_universal_jobs
    publish_universal_results
    publish_runtime_health
    run_cycle
    run_reporting_pipeline
    [ "$RUNNING" -ne 0 ] || break
    sleep "$LOOP_SECONDS" & wait $! || true
done

actions.content:
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORKER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/mirror_sync_worker.sh'
LAUNCHER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/mirror_sync_supervisor_entrypoint.sh'


def read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def test_queue_is_processed_before_mirror_cycle():
    text = read(WORKER)
    loop = text[text.index('while [ \"$RUNNING\" -eq 1 ]; do'):]
    assert loop.index('receive_universal_jobs') < loop.index('run_cycle')
    assert loop.index('dispatch_universal_jobs') < loop.index('run_cycle')
    assert loop.index('publish_universal_results') < loop.index('run_cycle')
    assert loop.index('publish_runtime_health') < loop.index('run_cycle')


def test_worker_subprocesses_are_timeout_bounded():
    text = read(WORKER)
    assert 'WORKER_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=' in text
    assert 'WORKER_MIRROR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=' in text
    assert 'WORKER_REPORTING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$@\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_MIRROR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$CHECK\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_MIRROR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$PUBLISH\" --publish' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_MIRROR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$FINALIZER\" \"$SNAPSHOT\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_REPORTING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$REPORTER\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$WORKER_REPORTING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$AUDIT_EXPORTER\"' in text


def test_launcher_subprocesses_are_timeout_bounded():
    text = read(LAUNCHER)
    assert 'LAUNCHER_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=' in text
    assert 'LAUNCHER_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$LAUNCHER_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$CHECK\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$LAUNCHER_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$APPLY\"' in text
    assert 'timeout \"$LAUNCHER_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\" \"$PYTHON_BIN\" \"$HEALTH\"' in text
